sources: UNI-ROYAL Thick Film Chip Resistors data sheet V.3 (Feb. 12, 2019), LCSC's copy https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/0a975aaa49b7c97f38a963127be4a823.pdf?productCode=C17630, read 2026-10-31 (one document for the series; it does not print the order code 0805W8F3300T5E)
order code (section 2–3, p. 2): 0805 = size, W8 = 1/8 W, F = ±1 %, 3300 = 330 × 10^0 Ω, T = tape and reel, 5 = 5000 pcs, E = lead free
ratings (section 7, p. 5): 0805 max. working voltage 150 V, max. overload voltage 300 V, operating temperature −55…155 °C; power rated up to 70 °C ambient, derated above (section 9, figure 1)
mpn, manufacturer, footprint, jlc_class, pin numbers and names: EasyEDA library data of C17630 via edakit part import, read 2026-10-31
stock: JLCPCB 1 821 620 pcs, Basic Part (edakit stock --lcsc, 2026-10-31)
notes: 330 Ω series resistor in the data line of addressable LEDs (block addressable-led-input). Library draft, sibling of C17414 and C17471.

verified.datasheet: UNI-ROYAL Thick Film Chip Resistors V.3 (2019-02-12)
open: the power derating above 70 °C ambient (figure 1, p. 5) is a curve – p_max_w is the value up to 70 °C
